quotes.text: Re-emit the new notification event to the newly registered listener.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The display manager creates an immediately available event target so UI listeners can register before storage initialization. If a listener registers after a notification became active, addEventListener sends that current notification to the new listener. Preserve this behavior when moving UI setup or splitting notification modules.
title: Replay the active notification to late listeners
